name: Single-Arm Front Lever Negative
description: A front lever regression where only one arm grips the bar while the body is lowered from vertical to horizontal. The negative (eccentric only) allows training the front lever position with one arm at a time. This is an intermediate step toward the one-arm front lever.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Single-Arm Front Lever Negative in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Single-Arm Front Lever Negative.
steps: Step 1: Hang from bar with one hand. Place other hand on wrist for support initially.
Step 2: Engage lat of working arm and slowly lower body to horizontal.
Step 3: Maintain rigid body throughout the negative.
Step 4: Lower fully then reset by using both hands to return to start.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
common_mistakes: Trying without full two-arm front lever
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: Full front lever mastery required first
